manifest.description: Effort a guardrail-gate commit gate cost per step, the gate's tests check and the fix rounds' correctness (gate-effort@7: a failed tests check counted once, blocking counts that compare across gate modes with and without the mypy no-untyped-call cascade, failing tests and missed coverage apart, first-pass clean rates that ignore auto-fixable layout codes, the tests check, or both), plus the cross-mode blocking counts without the cascade and with a refused suppression comment counted once (mypy's unused-ignore at a SUPPRESS line folded into it). A shadow gate reports its first-run, step-end and code outcomes only. Not applicable to an arm without a gate. Plus a guardrail-gate@4 autofix step's effect: passes, errors, files and lines changed, block-tier findings fixed by family, first-pass clean and blocking counts after autofix (and before, comparable across an enforced and a shadow gate), and the fix sessions' cost and wall time split by the kind of refusal that started them (coverage minimum apart).

spec.description: Does a commit gate enforcing the python-guardrails rule set change correctness and code quality on forge?
